discovery: Electromagnetic metamaterials: the theory and experimental realization of negative refraction and engineered electromagnetic response (including transformation optics)
rationale: Quantum physics was recognized in 2022 and 2025, and AI-related physics in 2024, so the committee is likely to move to another long-standing classical or condensed-matter candidate. Metamaterials are a mature, heavily cited field that has had real technological impact. Pendry (theory of negative-index media, perfect lenses and transformation optics) and Smith (first experimental demonstration of negative refraction and cloaking) have repeatedly been named as Nobel-level candidates.
